name: frontend-security
description: Use this skill when writing or reviewing client-side code for security implications. Covers XSS prevention, Content Security Policy, safe v-html usage, authentication token handling, secrets hygiene, and dependency security for Vue/TypeScript projects. Apply proactively when handling user input, rendering dynamic content, or managing auth state.
when: When writing or reviewing client-side code for security: XSS, CSP, auth tokens, secrets hygiene
do-not-use-when: Writing server-side code, API routes, or database queries
A general code review with no security implications
